value: At the shrine, the Tome answers by showing a remembered scene. Velinde Starsong calls to Elune as her companions dwindle and her own strength falters against the demons. In the vision, she receives the Scythe of Elune and regards it as an answer to her prayer. Melyria says the image leaves more to investigate. The quest does not make the Tome’s nature plain, and this first scene does not yet show how the gift will alter the danger in the forest.
editorNote: Attribution and evidential limits remain explicit in the transcript. This claim is based on a secondary transcription; original-client comparison remains open.
